faqs.a:
(a)
Any person entering the reservoir will do so only in a vehicle upon which is affixed
               a currently valid reservoir permit. Such permit must at all times be displayed on
               the upper left side of the front windshield of the vehicle. Permits for boats must
               be displayed on the right bow of the boat.
(b)
No person will enter the reservoir at any location except at the main entrance located
               on West 66th Avenue. Any person entering the reservoir must do so in a vehicle that
               has affixed to it a currently valid annual reservoir permit, or must purchase a daily
               permit for the vehicle and boat at the main entrance to the reservoir.
(c)
Not more than six people, including the permit holder, may enter the reservoir in
               a permitted vehicle.
(d)
No person in a permitted vehicle will drop off another person at the reservoir and
               then leave the reservoir.
(e)
Any person who enters the reservoir in violation of this section is guilty of
section 62-40
(a).
(Code 1981, § 22-26; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988; Ord. No. 2709, § 1, 3-5-1990;
               Ord. No. 2956, § 6, 2-15-1993)
